name: Spinach Mushroom Strata
ingredients: 1 loaf - Day-old Baguette or Crusty Bread, crust removed, 1 inch cubes
instructions: Toast bread cubes until golden brown
In a large saute pan over medium heat, cook onions, mushrooms, and herbs in butter until softened, ~7 minutes
Add spinach to pan and cook until spinach is wilted, then remove from heat and let cool
in a 9 inch square pan or round casserole, measure out the toasted bread to fill the bottom of the dish and place it in a mixing bowl
Add cooked vegetables and cheese to the bread, toss to combine
In a blender combine eggs, milk, cream, salt, pepper
Lightly grease the casserole dish, add the bread and onion mixture
Pour the bread cubes down to make sure they are totally submerged.
Bake the strata uncovered until it has puffed slightly, is golden brown and does not shimmy with uncooked egg mixture when shaken, ~1 hour 15 minutes.
If strata gets too dark, cover with foil and continue cooking
Let strata cool in the pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes.
Serve strata warm or at room temperature
